data.name: Deactivate a user
data.description: Removes a user from your Postman team and deactivates the account. This blocks the user from authenticating in to Postman.
data.evaluateGuide:
Removes a team user and disables authentication for that account.
Use for: deactivate team users, block account authentication, remove team access
Not supported: user creation, profile updates, team invitations

data.name: Deactivate an account holder
data.description: Updates an account holder. When updating an account holder resource, if a parameter is not provided in the request, it is left unchanged.
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an Adyen account holder resource, including deactivation when supported by its payload.
Use for: deactivate account holders, update holder details, change holder status
Not supported: creating holders, deleting holders, processing payments

data.name: User Info
data.evaluateGuide:
Returns identity and profile information for the authenticated Salesforce user.
Use for: retrieve user identity, inspect profile details, verify OAuth identity
Not supported: editing users, managing records, changing permissions

data.name: Deactivate a User
data.description: Deactivates a user in your account.
data.evaluateGuide:
Deactivates a LeadSquared user identified by the supplied user ID.
Use for: deactivate users, disable user access, retire user accounts
Not supported: creating users, updating profiles, deleting users

data.name: Read
data.evaluateGuide:
Reads Account Engagement account details and selected related administrator and creator fields.
Use for: retrieve account details, inspect API usage, view account contacts
Not supported: creating accounts, updating fields, deleting accounts

data.name: Deactivate a User
data.description: Deactivates a user. This operation can only be performed on users that do not have a DEPROVISIONED status. While the asynchronous operation (triggered by HTTP header Prefer: respond-async) is proceeding the user's transitioningToStatus property is DEPROVISIONED. The user's status is DEPROVISIONED when the deactivation process is complete.
data.evaluateGuide:
Deactivates an Okta user through its lifecycle endpoint, with optional asynchronous completion.
Use for: deactivate users, begin user deprovisioning, disable Okta access
Not supported: user creation, reactivation, group management

data.name: Forgot Password - Initialize
data.evaluateGuide:
Starts the Salesforce headless password-recovery flow for an account holder.
Use for: initialize password recovery, start forgot-password flow, assist account access
Not supported: resetting passwords directly, user administration, profile updates

data.name: Deactivate an Account
data.description: Deactivate an Account object that is fundamental to Xflow and model entities like direct users, connected users, partners and platforms.
data.evaluateGuide:
Deactivates an Xflow Account resource by its identifier.
Use for: deactivate accounts, disable account activity, retire account entities
Not supported: creating accounts, editing account details, processing transfers

data.name: Adds users to an account.
data.description:
Adds users to an account.
Required authentication scopes: user_write.
Related topics

How to create a new active eSignature user
data.evaluateGuide:
Adds users to a DocuSign organization account.
Use for: create account users, add eSignature users, provision active users
Not supported: deactivating users, editing existing users, removing users

data.name: Deactivate an Authenticator
data.evaluateGuide:
Deactivates an Okta authenticator using its authenticator identifier.
Use for: deactivate authenticators, retire authentication factors, disable factor options
Not supported: creating authenticators, enrolling factors, managing users
